fleet send
Dispatch ships on a mission. A transport may take resource=amount cargo and --dest-pays-return so the owned destination pays the empty return at launch. A colonize may take cargo up to the colony ship's hold; it lands as the new colony's starter stock. --speed PERCENT (10 to 100, default 100) trades time for fuel: a slower send flies a cheaper transfer and takes longer. The reply reports `fuel_water_ice` / `fuel_deuterium` plus `fuel_out_*` / `fuel_back_*` and `fuel_out_payer` / `fuel_back_payer`.

Usage: hoshi fleet send FROM TO MISSION [RESOURCE=AMOUNT...] SHIP:COUNT... [--dest-pays-return] [--speed PERCENT]

Uses the selected save and the same core rules as interactive play. Results use the versioned JSON envelope. A refused action does not bypass prerequisites or fair-play restrictions.

Example:
  hoshi fleet send 1:1:10 home transport water_ice=500 small_cargo:1 --speed 10

Environment: HOSHI_SAVE, HOSHI_BALANCE
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 invalid input; 3 action refused; 4 save locked; 5 internal or save error.
